title: Distributed Backtester Shutdown
description: Coordinator-to-worker control message. Asks the worker to finish the current job, if any, and stop. No reply is defined; the coordinator observes the connection closing.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, for editor support.

protocol_version.description: Wire protocol version. Only version 1 is supported.

message_id.description: Correlation key chosen by the coordinator, recorded in worker logs.

reason.description: Optional human-readable explanation, for logs and diagnostics.
